title: Static Four Hook-Limb Sloth on Curved Branch
description: One complete newly authored static sloth-like animal-on-branch display prop. A low hanging rounded torso with short blunt pale face has four long thick limbs that curve upward around a single continuous bent supporting branch; whole hooked paw ends sit over the branch rather than floating. Small forward dark eyes and a short nose finish the face, with no large tail or ears. The whole curved branch is part of this one fixed display and has one finite ground end; it is not offered as a separate reusable tree asset. All animal/branch sections and limb paths newly authored, not a squirrel with its tail removed or an owl body reused. One model, zero scenes, fixed pose. No exact species, claw/toe anatomy, real climbing/grasping, animation, rig, load capacity or safety claim.
